title: Credit spreads
summary: Selling far-OTM SPY credit spreads 0DTE (risk ~$100 to collect ~$2, ~2%) looks statistically safe since SPY often needs a ~1.7%+ move to breach, especially avoiding news days. And also spy usually moves less than 1.25 percent per day.But since one bad move can wipe out dozens of winning trades, how many traders here have actually achieved consistent long-term success with this strategy?submitted by/u/Antique_Fox_7890[link][comments]
